facts.value: Handles Zako Boy's item-drop notification by forwarding the fighter object and incoming boolean to Fighter_OnItemDrop with both remaining arguments set to zero. Shared handling always calls ftAnim_80070FB4(gobj, 0, -1) and conditionally calls ftAnim_80070CC4(gobj, 0) when the incoming boolean is true.

facts.rationale: Zero-valued arguments do not disable the shared handler; preserves the heavy-item exception and independent catch-flag branch.
facts.value: Handles Zako Boy's item-pickup notification by forwarding the fighter object and incoming boolean to Fighter_OnItemPickup with both remaining arguments set to zero. Shared handling skips heavy items; for other items it selects a numeric animation-helper value according to hold kind and separately invokes ftAnim_80070C48(gobj, 0) when the incoming boolean is true.

facts.value: Item callbacks forward fighter objects and incoming event booleans to shared handlers with fixed zero boolean arguments. Death cleanup requests model group 0's pending selection 0. OnLoad copies ftZakoboyAttributes from ft_data->ext_attr into dat_attrs_backup and installs that pointer as dat_attrs; LoadSpecialAttrs copies external attributes through the existing dat_attrs pointer.
